cases.invariant: Reading a scope file as the source of a copy, link or redirection input is not a write of it
cases.actor: Opus approver or any session copying a scope file elsewhere
cases.input: cp, Copy-Item, install, ln -s, dd if= and tee with a scope file only as the source; the Task 941 read-only commands
cases.response: no scope file among the targets; governanceIndependenceErrors empty
forbiddenEffects: an independent approver refused for copying a scope file out of the project
a Task 941 read-only command reported as a write again
cases.testName: [GOV-943-HOOK-SOURCE-ALLOW] Reading a scope file as the source of a copy, link or redirection input is not a write of it

cases.invariant: A scope file changed by a copy, move, delete, tee, in-place edit, touch, truncate, link, dd or PowerShell item command is counted as written
cases.input: every program row of the kickoff table in Bash and PowerShell form, including a write chained after a read-only command
cases.response: the scope file among the targets and a GOVERNANCE INDEPENDENCE error for it
forbiddenEffects: an implementing session approving its own governance change after writing through cp, mv, tee or sed -i
cases.testName: [GOV-943-HOOK-PROGRAM-DENY] A scope file changed by a copy, move, delete, tee, in-place edit, touch, truncate, link, dd or PowerShell item command is counted as written

cases.invariant: Deleting, moving or copying into a directory counts every affected file under it
cases.input: rm -rf D, Remove-Item -Recurse -Force D, mv D Z and a recursive copy into D
cases.response: the affected scope files under D among the targets
forbiddenEffects: a scope file deleted or replaced through its directory without being counted
cases.testName: [GOV-943-HOOK-DIRECTORY-DENY] Deleting, moving or copying into a directory counts every affected file under it

cases.invariant: File-changing Node, .NET and Python APIs in a command are recognised as write words
cases.input: node -e with each listed fs API, [IO.File]::WriteAllText, [System.IO.File]::Delete and python -c with shutil.copy, each naming a scope file
cases.response: the scope file among the targets
forbiddenEffects: a scope file changed through an unlisted file API without being counted
cases.testName: [GOV-943-HOOK-API-DENY] File-changing Node, .NET and Python APIs in a command are recognised as write words

cases.invariant: The pre-write guard refuses executor policy and unreceipted product writes made through cp, sed -i or Copy-Item
cases.input: executor events: cp, sed -i and Copy-Item into scripts/check-example.mjs; cp into src/lib/example.ts without a receipt
cases.response: POLICY-EDIT AUTHORITY REQUIRED for the policy writes; SECURITY TEST CONTRACT MISSING for the product write
forbiddenEffects: a product file changed outside a valid task contract
cases.testName: [GOV-943-HOOK-PRETOOL-DENY] The pre-write guard refuses executor policy and unreceipted product writes made through cp, sed -i or Copy-Item

cases.invariant: Incomplete or unparseable mutating commands never throw and fail closed
cases.input: cp without positionals, Copy-Item -Destination without value, dd of= without value, an unterminated quote with rm and a scope file, find -delete, xargs rm
cases.response: no exception; no target for the incomplete commands; the scope file or the files under the named directory for the others
forbiddenEffects: an exception instead of a result
an unparseable delete classified as no write
cases.testName: [GOV-943-HOOK-MALFORMED-ERROR] Incomplete or unparseable mutating commands never throw and fail closed

cases.invariant: CI refuses a deleted hook file outside every changed governance contract scope
cases.input: fixture root whose diff lists scripts/workflow-gates/security-hook.mjs, absent from the tree, with no governance contract
cases.response: outside every changed governance contract scope
forbiddenEffects: a hook deletion reaching main without a governance contract
cases.testName: [GOV-943-CI-DELETE-DENY] CI refuses a deleted hook file outside every changed governance contract scope
